distinction_drawn_deliberately.removed: limits invented by a reviewing assistant that constrained scope, roles, tooling, topology or pace without founder consent
distinction_drawn_deliberately.retained: controls that exist because they caught real defects in this estate — the write-scope guard, manifest closure, read-back by recomputation, the allowlist capacity detector, and independent acceptance
distinction_drawn_deliberately.reasoning: The founder directed removal of restrictions that hindered progress, not removal of the machinery that makes scaled work admissible. An independent acceptor refusing this controller's own evidence a few hours ago is the evidence that the second class earns its place.
